title: Health endpoint reports environment
description: GET /health returns 200 with the active environment name.

title: Domestic standard quote uses integer-cents arithmetic
description: compute_quote_cents(weight_g=500, DOMESTIC, STANDARD) returns an exact int equal to base_cents + per_gram_cents*weight_g, never a float.

title: Quote weight ceiling is enforced
description: compute_quote_cents rejects weight_g above MAX_WEIGHT_G with InvalidQuoteRequest.

title: EXPRESS service respects the express feature flag
description: compute_quote_cents rejects service=EXPRESS when express_enabled is False.

title: Config loader rejects unknown environment names
description: load_config_file raises ConfigValidationError when environment is not in {ST, SIT, UAT}.

title: Config validation errors never echo secret reference values
description: When a secrets.* value is present alongside an unrelated validation failure, the raised error message string does not contain that secret reference.

title: Config loader accepts a well-formed environment document
description: load_config_file parses a valid ST config and exposes gateway_retry_count and express_service_enabled correctly.

title: Role not in allow-list is rejected
description: auth.require_role raises AuthorizationError when role is not a member of allowed_roles.

title: Gateway retries once on timeout before succeeding
description: GatewaySimulator with outcomes=[timeout, success] confirms on attempt 2 and reports attempts=2.

title: Decline outcome is never retried
description: GatewaySimulator with outcomes=[decline, success] raises GatewayUnavailableError after exactly one attempt, even with retries remaining.

title: Fallback is used once retries are exhausted
description: GatewaySimulator with retry_count=1, fallback_enabled=True, outcomes=[timeout, timeout] returns a FALLBACK-QUEUED confirmation with used_fallback=True.

title: Booking persists and round-trips through SQLite
description: insert_booking followed by get_booking returns the same quote_id and status that were inserted.
metadata_notes: Requirement link not re-reviewed since initial authoring; this test exercises persistence mechanics more than booking business behavior. Verify before relying on this mapping.

title: Oversized request bodies are rejected before JSON parsing
description: parse_quote_request raises InvalidQuoteRequest when body exceeds MAX_BODY_BYTES.

title: Unknown fields in quote requests are rejected
description: parse_quote_request raises InvalidQuoteRequest when the request body contains a field outside the fixed schema.

title: End-to-end shipping quote and checkout verification
description: Narrow assertion only: POST /api/quotes for a DOMESTIC/STANDARD/500g request returns amount_cents == 1000 as an int. Despite the title, this does not exercise checkout, booking, or any non-DOMESTIC/STANDARD path.

title: Quote request without a role header is forbidden
description: POST /api/quotes without X-Demo-Role returns HTTP 403.

title: Quote error responses never leak secret references
description: An invalid POST /api/quotes response body never contains the literal string 'secret://'.

title: Booking confirms successfully end-to-end over real HTTP
description: POST /api/bookings for a valid quote with a forced success outcome returns 201 with status=CONFIRMED and attempts=1.

title: Booking falls back to queued state over real HTTP
description: POST /api/bookings with simulated outcomes [timeout, timeout] and fallback_enabled=True returns 201 with status=CONFIRMED_FALLBACK.

title: Booking against a nonexistent quote returns 404
description: POST /api/bookings with a quote_id that was never created returns HTTP 404 and does not call the gateway.

title: Static UI file serving rejects path traversal
description: GET /ui/../../pyproject.toml (and similar traversal attempts) return 404, never the file outside ui/.

title: Storefront consumer adapter completes quote-then-book flow
description: StorefrontClient.request_quote followed by create_booking against a real running server returns a CONFIRMED booking.

title: Operations consumer adapter reads booking status
description: OperationsClient.get_booking returns the same booking_id and status as were created via the storefront flow.

title: Quote API response conforms to the documented OpenAPI schema
description: A real POST /api/quotes response validates against components.schemas.QuoteResponseV1 in openapi/openapi.json using the stdlib-only schema-subset validator.

title: Booking API response conforms to the documented OpenAPI schema
description: A real POST /api/bookings response validates against components.schemas.BookingResponse in openapi/openapi.json.

title: SIT runtime snapshot agrees with SIT repository config
description: Compares the synthetic captured snapshot snapshots/sit-runtime-snapshot.json against config/sit.json for gateway base URL, timeout, retry count, and the express feature flag.

title: UI escapeHtml prevents markup injection
description: escapeHtml('&') returns '<b>&</b>'. Node built-in test runner, not a browser execution.
executable_selector: node --test ui/assets/validation.test.js (test: "escapeHtml escapes angle brackets and ampersands")

title: UI quote form validation rejects non-numeric weight
description: validateQuoteForm({weightG: 'abc', ...}) returns valid=false with at least one error. Node built-in test runner, not a browser execution.

title: Manual: run the Postman collection against a local instance
description: Start the demo server locally, import openapi/postman_collection.json into Postman (or an equivalent HTTP client), set baseUrl and role, and manually execute each request, confirming 2xx responses and plausible field values.
manual_steps: Start the demo server locally with: python -c "from parcelflow import db; from parcelflow.app import create_server; from parcelflow.config import load_environment, default_config_dir; import json; cfg = load_environment('ST', config_dir=default_config_dir()); conn = db.connect('parcelflow-demo.db'); db.init_schema(conn); rate_card = json.load(open('reference-data/rate_card.json')); server = create_server(cfg, rate_card, conn, port=8101, ui_dir='ui'); print('Serving on http://127.0.0.1:8101'); server.serve_forever()" (see README.md "Run locally" section for the same snippet). | Open openapi/postman_collection.json in Postman. | Set the baseUrl collection variable to the running server's address. | Execute 'Health check' and confirm status 200. | Execute 'Create quote (domestic standard)' and confirm status 201 and an integer amount_cents. | Copy the returned quote_id into 'Create booking' and execute it; confirm status 201. | Copy the returned booking_id into 'Get booking by id' and execute it; confirm the status matches.

title: Manual: UI role visibility and accessibility walkthrough
description: Manually open ui/index.html against a running server, switch the role selector, and visually confirm labels, focus order, and ARIA live regions behave sensibly. This is a manual/static check, not an automated browser test.
manual_steps: Start the demo server on a known port. | Serve or open ui/index.html pointed at that server. | Tab through the form; confirm every input has a visible label and logical tab order. | Switch the role selector between customer/ops/admin and submit a quote for each; confirm the UI does not crash and errors render as text (not raw HTML). | Confirm the #quote-errors and #quote-result regions have aria-live='polite' and update sensibly.

title: Environment-driven behavior genuinely follows each environment's config file
description: For every known environment, loads the real config/<env>.json and asserts EXPRESS availability, quote role restrictions, and gateway retry-attempt bounds all genuinely follow that file's values -- not a hardcoded expectation.
coverage_elements: parcelflow.config.load_environment | parcelflow.pricing.compute_quote_cents (express gating) | parcelflow.auth.require_role (role allow-list) | parcelflow.gateway.GatewaySimulator (retry bound)
